question: Three real numbers $a,b,c$ are such that $a^2,b^2,c^2$ are terms of an arithmetic progression. Then

options.A: $a,b,c$ are terms of a geometric progression
options.B: $(b+c),(c+a),(a+b)$ are terms of an arithmetic progression
options.C: $(b+c),(c+a),(a+b)$ are terms of a harmonic progression
options.D: none of the foregoing statements is necessarily true

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
